documentation: Instrumented key/value `store` backend for exercising the mhl extension mechanism under load. Superset of store-fs: one JSON file per key under `dir` (persists across processes), plus per-call logging, injected latency, chaos-crash, and a serial/concurrent toggle — all read from the declaration's own properties.

properties.name: dir
properties.documentation: Filesystem root for the store. Ephemeral temp dir when omitted.

properties.name: log
properties.documentation: Path to append one JSON line per handled message (init / call / shutdown / crash).

properties.name: latency_ms
properties.documentation: Sleep this many milliseconds inside every call — to force interleaving / act as a bottleneck.

properties.name: crash_after
properties.documentation: os.Exit(1) after this many calls — exercises the host's respawn / maxRestarts path.

properties.name: serial
properties.documentation: Handle one call at a time (store-fs behaviour). Default: a goroutine per call.

methods.name: get
methods.documentation: The value at key, or null when absent.

methods.name: delete
methods.documentation: Remove key. Absent key is not an error.

methods.name: list
methods.documentation: Every key with the given prefix.
